sable_player_ragdoll_patch.configuration: When enabled, ragdolls holding luminous items such as torches emit dynamic light through Sodium/Embeddium Dynamic Lights and LambDynamicLights, and the ragdoll model itself is brightened to match the held light.
Applies hidden armor and cosmetic armor overrides from Cosmetic Armor Reworked and Accessories when rendering ragdoll corpses. Requires the corresponding mods to toggle meaningful behavior.

Renders Dynamic Lantern waist items and Beltborne Lanterns/Accessories Layer lamps on ragdoll corpses, and lets supported waist lanterns contribute to ragdoll dynamic lights. Requires the corresponding mods to toggle meaningful behavior.
Hides capes on ragdoll corpses even if the player had cape rendering enabled. Other skin customization parts still follow the player's settings captured at death.
Disables Leawind's Third Person camera while the local player is self-ragdolled, letting Sable handle both falling down and standing up to avoid camera snap-back.
Cancels container and door interactions while the player is grabbing a ragdoll part.
Default state of No-Collide mode when the server or world loads. When enabled, ragdoll part blocks have no collision to reduce players and mobs getting stuck.
When ragdoll-corpse is installed, prevents interacting with a ragdoll corpse while the player is grabbing any part of that ragdoll.
